title: Improvement: Provide an async stream of newly available services
body:
### What

The Rust API currently discovers services through` find_service::<I>()` which creates a discovery handle scoped to an interface and a `FindServiceSpecifier` Its async query returns an initial result, it does not continuously report services offered afterward.

Add an asynchronous stream that reports newly available services across the system, rather than only additional instances matching one service instance specifier. Since services may belong to different interfaces, stream items should provide interface-independent service descriptors, including enough information to identify each service.

**Acceptance criteria:**

The stream reports newly available services system-wide, not only later instances for one specifier.
Each item identifies its service and interface.
The API documents initial results, errors, and stream lifetime/termination.
Existing interface-scoped discovery APIs remain available.

Reference - https://github.com/eclipse-score/communication/issues/9
